targets.encoding: UTF-8 JSON with exactly the stated keys. Scalar: 64 lowercase hex characters, no prefix. Point: null for infinity, otherwise {x,y}, each 64 lowercase hex characters representing a big-endian integer less than p. Reject duplicate keys, noncanonical values and off-curve points.

targets.curve_equation_G1: y^2 = x^3 + 4 over Fp; G1=<P0> of order r
targets.curve_equation_G2: y^2 = x^3 + 4*(1+u) over Fp2; G2=<Q0> of order r
targets.field_Fp12: Fp[w]/(w^12-2*w^6+2); coefficient list [c0,...,c11] means sum(ci*w^i); u maps to w^6-1
targets.group_GT: Nonzero z in Fp12 with z^r=1; identity [1,0,...,0]

pairing.definition: e(P,Q)=py_ecc.optimized_bls12_381.pairing(Q,P,final_exponentiate=True) at the pinned commit. Argument order is reversed in the library. Raw Miller output is not the target.

targets.challenge: Sample a uniformly from 0..r-1 by rejection sampling; give only z=e(P0,Q0)^a. Neither a nor [a]P0 nor sampling coins are given. This samples uniform GT, including identity.
targets.acceptance: Decode z canonically; require z!=0 and z^r=1. Decode P canonically, require P on G1 curve and [r]P=infinity. Accept exactly when e(P,Q0)=z, comparing all 12 coefficients. Infinity is valid exactly for z=1.
targets.encoding: UTF-8 JSON with exactly the stated keys. Each Fp coefficient: 96 lowercase hex characters, no prefix, big-endian integer less than p. GT: exactly 12 coefficients in increasing polynomial degree. Point: null for infinity, otherwise {x,y} with Fp coefficients. Reject duplicate keys, noncanonical values, off-curve and wrong-subgroup points.
